items.title: File Klage against rejection of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: The one-month Klage period runs from 'Bekanntgabe des Bescheids' (deemed delivery of this authority letter, normally the letter's posting date plus the statutory delivery-fiction days under §41 VwVfG NRW, then §§187,188,193 BGB counting with weekend/holiday shift). However, the letter as provided carries no printed date (no 'Datum' field), so the start of the delivery-fiction period cannot be fixed. Running compute_deadline without a document_date confirms no date can be derived. The due date is therefore left open; once the actual date on the original letter or its envelope/postmark is known, the one-month period would be counted from Bekanntgabe (received date + fiction) to the same day-number in the following month, shifted to the next business day if that falls on a weekend or NRW public holiday.

warnings: The letter has no printed date (no 'Datum' field is shown), so the one-month Klage deadline running from 'Bekanntgabe des Bescheids' cannot be computed exactly — check the original letter or its envelope postmark for the actual date/delivery day and count one month from that Bekanntgabe date, shifting to the next business day if it lands on a weekend or NRW holiday.
The letter states 'ein Vorverfahren entfällt', so no Widerspruch is possible — only direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, as stated in the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung.
